verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both have the same problems. The two badges ('Back by demand', 'Summer only') sit stranded below the CTA, which puts the reading order out of sequence. The subhead is tiny, and large dead gaps sit above and below the phone. A breaks the headline into three lines and leaves 'back' alone on the last line. B keeps the headline to two lines, which reads better, but it runs almost to the right edge and starts slightly left of the other elements' left edge.
